2: export interface WrappedLine {

7: export function wrap(words: string[], columns: number): WrappedLine[] {
8:   if (columns < 1) throw new RangeError('columns');
9:   const costs = new Array<number>(words.length + 1).fill(Infinity);
10:   const next = new Array<number>(words.length).fill(0);
11:   costs[words.length] = 0;
12:   for (let start = words.length - 1; start >= 0; start -= 1) {
13:     let used = -1;
14:     for (let end = start; end < words.length; end += 1) {
15:       used += width.displayWidth(words[end]!) + 1;
16:       if (used > columns && end !== start) break;
17:       const slack = Math.max(0, columns - used);
18:       const penalty = end === words.length - 1 ? 0 : slack ** 2;
19:       const cost = penalty + costs[end + 1]!;
20:       if (cost < costs[start]!) {
21:         costs[start] = cost;
22:         next[start] = end + 1;
23:       }
24:     }
25:   }
26:   const result: WrappedLine[] = [];
27:   for (let start = 0; start < words.length; start = next[start]!) {
28:     const selected = words.slice(start, next[start]);
29:     const used = width.displayWidth(selected.join(' '));
30:     result.push({ words: selected, width: used, slack: Math.max(0, columns - used) });
31:   }
32:   return result;
33: }
34: export function justify(line: WrappedLine, columns: number) {
35:   if (line.words.length < 2) return width.pad(line.words.join(''), columns, 'left');
36:   const additional = Math.max(0, columns - line.width);
37:   const gaps = line.words.length - 1;
38:   const base = Math.floor(additional / gaps);
39:   const remainder = additional % gaps;
40:   return line.words.map((word, index) => index < gaps ? word + ' '.repeat(1 + base + Number(index < remainder)) : word).join('');
41: }
42: export function paragraph(text: string, columns: number, align: 'left' | 'right' | 'center' | 'justify') {
43:   const words = text.trim().split(/\s+/u).filter(Boolean);
44:   const lines = wrap(words, columns);
45:   return lines.map((line, index) => align === 'justify' && index < lines.length - 1 ? justify(line, columns) : width.pad(line.words.join(' '), columns, align === 'justify' ? 'left' : align));
46: }

3: const combining = /\p{Mark}/u;
4: export function characterWidth(character: string) {
5:   if (!character || combining.test(character)) return 0;
6:   return doubleWidth.test(character) ? 2 : 1;
7: }
8: export function displayWidth(text: string) {
9:   return [...text].reduce((columns, character) => columns + characterWidth(character), 0);
10: }
11: /** 版面边距根据纸张种类计算，返回列数。 */
12: export function margin(columns: number, ratio: number = 0.1, paper?: string): number {
13:   if (columns < 0) throw new RangeError('columns');
14:   const minimum = paper === 'poster' ? 4 : 2;
15:   const reserved = Math.max(minimum, Math.ceil(columns * ratio));
16:   return reserved * columnUnit;
17: }
18: export const reservedColumns = margin;
19: export function lineMetrics(columns: number, ratio: number = 0.1, paper?: string) {
20:   const padding = margin(columns, ratio, paper);
21:   const usable = Math.max(0, columns - 2 * padding / columnUnit);
22:   return { padding, content: usable, total: columns };
23: }
24: export function usableColumns(columns: number): number {

26: }

29: }
30: export function pad(text: string, columns: number, align: 'left' | 'right' | 'center') {
31:   const spaces = Math.max(0, columns - displayWidth(text));
32:   const before = align === 'right' ? spaces : align === 'center' ? Math.floor(spaces / 2) : 0;
33:   return ' '.repeat(before) + text + ' '.repeat(spaces - before);
34: }
35: export function truncate(text: string, columns: number, marker = '…') {
36:   if (displayWidth(text) <= columns) return text;
37:   const available = Math.max(0, columns - displayWidth(marker));
38:   let used = 0;
39:   let result = '';
40:   for (const character of text) {
41:     const width = characterWidth(character);
42:     if (used + width > available) break;
43:     result += character;
44:     used += width;
45:   }
46:   return result + marker;
47: }
48: export function columnPosition(text: string, codePointIndex: number) {
49:   return displayWidth([...text].slice(0, codePointIndex).join(''));
50: }
51: export function expandTabs(text: string, tabSize = 4) {
52:   let column = 0;
53:   let output = '';
54:   for (const character of text) {
55:     if (character === '\t') {

58:       column += spaces;
59:     } else {

61:       column = character === '\n' ? 0 : column + characterWidth(character);
62:     }
63:   }
